subject: SOC 2 Type II starter request — report, bridge letter options & compressed evidence paths
messages:
From: Emma Wong <emma.wong@acme-industries.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acme-industries.com
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II report request (audit period Q2 2024) + bridge letter?

Hi Irene,

We're kicking off our vendor assurance for an upcoming procurement review and need Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report covering the period 2024-04-01 to 2024-09-30. Alongside the report, our security team asks for a bridge letter if the report's end date doesn't align with our controls window.

Questions:
- Do you have a Type II (not just Type I) we can share internally?
- If the latest report ends earlier than our window, would Redwood provide a bridge letter (short statement that nothing material changed)?
- Preferred secure transfer for reports/attachments (S3 presigned link or shared Drive)?

We attached a short request form (acme-request-form.pdf) describing what our vendor team needs. Can you confirm timeline to deliver and any minimal attachments we should expect to provide?

Thanks,
Emma Wong
Vendor Assurance
Acme Industries

Attachment: acme-request-form.pdf

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Emma Wong <emma.wong@acme-industries.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request (audit period Q2 2024) + bridge letter?

Hi Emma — thanks for the clear ask and the form. Looping in Neha (security & compliance) and David (security engineering) so we can get you a concise package.

Short answers up front:
- Yes — we have a SOC 2 Type II report (Redwood Inference) from an independent CPA.
- If our report end date doesn't match your exact window, we can provide a bridge letter / continuity statement. We include scope and dates in the bridge.
- Preferred transfer: we can provide either a time-limited S3 presigned link (recommended for larger bundles) or a secure Drive folder with restricted access. We can also provide a hashed manifest for integrity.

Next steps / timeline proposal:
1) Neha to confirm the latest report end date and whether a bridge letter exists (goal: same day response).
2) We'll prepare a minimal deliverable set: final PDF report, bridge letter (if needed), scope map, and an attachments manifest (CSV).
3) We can get a presigned S3 link to you within 48 hours after you confirm the preferred transfer method.

One quick ask from our side: can you confirm whether you need auditor contact details or just the report + bridge? That helps redact any sensitive auditor information if required.

Below are two short reply snippets you can use internally if helpful (one-line variants we send often):
- "Redwood confirms a Type II report is available; will provide via S3 presigned link and a bridge letter if audit window misaligns."
- "Request accepted — Redwood will deliver report + bridge letter; need to confirm transfer method and auditor contact preference."

Neha / David — can you confirm the latest report end date and upload window?

Best,
Irene
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Emma Wong <emma.wong@acme-industries.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 12:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request (audit period Q2 2024) + bridge letter?

Thanks — I pulled the records. Latest SOC 2 Type II report we completed covers 2024-01-01 through 2024-06-30 (Type II, System and Organization Controls).

Because Acme's requested window extends to 2024-09-30, we'll provide a short bridge letter that states:
- the audited period covered (2024-01-01 to 2024-06-30),
- whether any material control changes were made after the period end, and
- contact info for our audit firm if you need direct confirmation.

What we propose to share (minimal bundle):
- Redwood Inference SOC 2 Type II Report (PDF)
- Bridge letter (PDF) — draft attached for review
- Scope map (one-pager) — lists services included/excluded
- Attachments manifest (CSV) — file list, checksums, sizes

I attached a brief draft bridge letter for Acme's intake team to review. If you prefer a compressed bundle (single ZIP) we can provide that via S3 presigned link.

One-liner templates you can paste into your ticketing system:
- "Redwood: Type II report + bridge letter (if needed) — transfer via presigned S3 link; bundle includes report, bridge, scope map, manifest."

Emma — please confirm: S3 presigned link OK? Any organizational rules about retaining original auditor contacts? If you prefer we remove the auditor's direct telephone from the copy, we can redact phone numbers but keep name and firm.

Attachment: redwood-bridge-letter-draft.pdf

From: Emma Wong <emma.wong@acme-industries.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acme-industries.com
Date: Fri, 13 Jun 2025 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request (audit period Q2 2024) + bridge letter?

Hi Neha/Irene — S3 presigned link is fine and actually preferred by our procurement. We do not need the auditor phone number; name and firm is enough.

We'll accept the bundle you listed. Please include the manifest CSV so our intake team can confirm checksums after download. Timeline: if you can share the presigned S3 link and bundle by end-of-day Monday (2025-06-16), we'll mark the intake as complete and proceed with our internal review.

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the draft bridge letter — we'll review and confirm any minor edits in a follow-up.

Best,
Emma Wong
Vendor Assurance, Acme Industries
Attachment referenced: presigned-s3-link.txt (once provided by Redwood)
